features.note: The overview shows the front band, central spine and eight labeled 4+4 rooms, but the rear technical/service rectangles and their continuous separated corridor are not legible together strongly enough to verify the promised circulation grammar.

The L/M/S labels and stepped red blocks suggest three families, but the saved views do not make 2/4/2 family width, height and row-density differences independently readable without labels; screen/portal/emergency-door structure remains schematic.

Lobby, concessions and checkpoint read as adjacent colored zones, and five facade entries are visible, but the kitchen closeups show generic blocks rather than a hood-to-duct connection and the accessible path/checkpoint clearances are not visually traceable.

The complete-network engineering view shows green, dashed cyan and solid blue media plus the external chain, but exact endpoint membership and trunk/drop contacts are too small and cluttered to verify; several runs appear to end in open space or cross walls without visible containment.
Paired views preserve the same shell and camera intent while changing from opaque architecture to translucent sectioned engineering with highlighted routes and devices.

important_features.note: Door and room scale is plausible, but no human reference is visible and the tiny devices cannot be compared reliably with counters, seats and openings across the saved views.
Structural forms remain visible, but flat white/black presentation and very dark wide views do not yet establish the promised bright-public to dim-auditorium hierarchy.

Green and blue routes visibly cross open space, slabs and translucent walls; the kitchen view lacks a readable hood/duct root and the UG67 view does not show cable/antenna termination continuity clearly.

defects: The kitchen architecture and engineering closeups are dominated by counters and route lines; no hood outlet-to-extract-duct root is visible, and multiple green segments terminate in open air.

The auditorium views show simple stepped blocks and pale screen rectangles, while acoustic entry portals, door-leaf depth and emergency-door frames are not consistently distinguishable as true wall openings.
The technical architecture view is too oblique to prove the rear room rectangles, 1.5 m service corridor, separating wall and service doors in one continuous non-overlapping circulation read.
The facade has five framed glazed panels and a wider center panel, but the yellow accessible route is not visibly aligned to the center opening and appears to run behind the right-side entry zone.

The complete-network and section views contain many detached-looking green/cyan segments; exact RS-485 terminal-to-trunk-to-drop contacts and wall/containment transitions cannot be confirmed from the pixels.

The UG67 architecture capture is almost entirely a blank wall, and the engineering closeup shows the gateway and antennas but does not clearly prove both antenna-root socket contacts or a contained Ethernet termination.
Large, medium and small auditorium envelopes rely primarily on labels; their structural height/width/stepping differences are not strong enough to read independently across the 2/4/2 set.
corrections: Expose the kitchen hood, its outlet and the vertical extract duct in a saved closeup; make the duct visibly overlap the hood socket and remove every floating route stub from that view.

Cut auditorium entrances and exterior emergency exits as unmistakable wall voids with visible jamb, lintel, threshold and leaf depth; add a readable acoustic portal thickness around each corridor entry.

Reframe the technical view to show the full rear service corridor and technical-room rectangles together; keep a continuous 1.5 m clear strip and show each framed service door connecting through the separating wall without overlap.
Align a continuous accessible forecourt route with the wider center facade opening, keep all five glazed entry frames unobstructed, and show the center threshold width clearly from the facade preset.
Make marquee and sign loads read as supported: terminate every projecting member into the facade/canopy and eliminate any bar that appears suspended or clipped through the red beam.

Rework the engineering containment so every RS-485 trunk begins at its UC100 terminal, every drop terminates at a visible TC300 endpoint, and wall crossings use visible trays, junctions or sleeves rather than open-air line intersections.

Produce contact-readable UG67 evidence with both vertical antenna roots seated on the gateway sockets and the Ethernet run visibly terminating at its port; keep wireless UC-to-UG67 links dashed and non-physical.
Increase the visible structural distinction among large, medium and small auditorium envelopes and stepped row masses so the 2/4/2 family arrangement reads without relying on L/M/S labels.

mechanical.note: All matching console sidecars report clean; probe medians are 96 draws and 9904 tris within the specified 550/750000 budget. FPS is informational only.
